name: pandects
description: Executable credit laws with broken specimens and reduced counterexamples.

interface.shortDescription: Executable credit laws with broken specimens and reduced counterexamples.
interface.longDescription: Pandects supplies executable credit laws for facts a fuzzer cannot choose by itself: conservation, accrual, withdrawal, time, queues, and changing terms. Each law includes a Solidity component, a deliberately broken specimen it is proved to catch, a reduced counterexample, justified bounds, and an applicability contract over economic observables rather than implementation names. It is not a fuzzer or a whole-protocol audit. Structured search records currently cover Foundry only; Echidna and Medusa results remain audit prose.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $pandects to check this credit protocol against the executable laws in the corpus.
